# Phase 3 — baselines B1, B2, B3

*Generated by `hydrocascade rootcause` on 2026-09-17.*

> ### ⚠ Fitted on synthetic data
>
> `data_mode` is `synthetic` for `era5_land`, `glofas`, `imd`, `imerg`, and 9,764 of
> 9,765 catalog rows are synthetic stand-ins. **Every number in this report describes
> the stand-in generators, not Kerala.** They are here to show the procedure runs end
> to end and that the diagnostics fire. Switching `data_mode` to `real` and rerunning
> `hydrocascade rootcause` turns all of them into results with no code change.


Doc 06 §7: *"if you build baselines only after the novel model, you will unconsciously tune the baseline to lose. Build them first, honestly, while you have no result to protect."* These are built before any cascade model exists.

**AUC-PR is the headline metric**, not AUC-ROC: under the sampling imbalance ROC is optimistic, and the operational question is precision among the days we raise an alarm.

### The benchmark comparison Doc 06 §5.5 asks for

A 2026 study reports flood susceptibility AUC-ROC around **0.905** for Kerala. Our spatial-block numbers will normally be lower, and that is the honest comparison rather than a defect: a random split over a 30 m grid lets a model see almost the same hillside in both folds. The optimism column above measures exactly how much that is worth on this data. Reporting a lower-but-more-honest number and explaining it is a strength signal; a suspiciously high one is not.
